The strongest underfollowed lane candidates are Seneca Foods for private-label/value-channel food manufacturing, Oil-Dri for private-label/value-retail household consumables, Neogen for food-safety and traceability inputs, and SPS Commerce for retailer-supplier EDI/compliance infrastructure.
